headline: NYY @ KCR matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is NYY 4.33 at KCR 3.34, with a projected total of 7.67. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward NYY: NYY moved -0.17 runs while KCR moved -1.24, changing the projected margin by +1.07 runs. The projected total fell -1.41, which points to a lower-run game script than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability rose +8.5%, so the first-inning read became more pitcher-friendly early. Pitching context: Cam Schlittler has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 0.8 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Jazz Chisholm Jr., Bobby Witt Jr., Maikel Garcia, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Austin Wells, Ryan McMahon because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
